_README: Bandit SAST baseline for the invariants job (code review 2026-08-07, CICD-9).
Regenerate with the EXACT command in .github/workflows/ci.yml, run on Linux:
bandit -r services/*/app shared -ll -q -f json -o ops/ci/bandit-baseline.json
Linux paths matter — a baseline generated on Windows carries backslashes and
matches nothing on ubuntu-latest, which reads as a clean scan rather than a
broken one.
-o OVERWRITES this file, and bandit does not know _README exists, so a
regeneration DELETES the triage below. Copy this block out first and paste
it back into the new file, then re-check every line against the new results
before committing — restoring it verbatim would re-assert a triage nobody
performed, which is the failure mode the counts below already had once.
This is a RATCHET, not an acceptance: the 11 entries below are what existed
when SAST was first switched on. Gating at zero would have turned the build
red on arrival, and the honest options then are block-every-PR or switch-the-
gate-off. Anything NEW at MEDIUM or above fails the build. Shrinking this file
is the work; growing it needs a reason in the commit message.
Known entries, each triaged rather than waved through. The five groups below
sum to 11, which is the number of results in this file — an inventory that
does not add up is how an untriaged entry hides in a list that looks
complete, and this one did not add up until 2026-08-15 (it described 10).
B104 host="0.0.0.0" x4, one per service config.py - containers must bind
the container interface; the published surface is Caddy alone
(docker-compose.prod.yml).
B104 x1 in data_gateway/app/utils/request_ip.py::validated_ip - NOT a bind
address. It is the value RETURNED when neither the parsed client IP
nor the socket-peer fallback is a valid address: a sentinel that is
still a valid INET, so the DPDP consent-ledger write cannot fail on
it. Nothing listens on it; the line already carries its own noqa.
Separate entry because the reasoning is different — the four above
are accepted risks about container networking, this one is a false
positive and would survive any hardening of those four.
B608 x4 - f-string SQL. Each interpolates an in-code identifier (a column or
ORDER BY direction chosen from a fixed set), never request input.
Re-read them before deleting this line.
B108 /tmp/interview_worker_heartbeat - a path INSIDE the container, read by
the compose healthcheck; not a shared-host temp file.
B701 jinja2 autoescape=False in feedback_billing/app/scorer.py - the template
renders an LLM PROMPT, not HTML. Autoescaping would corrupt the prompt.
Flagged here so the next reader checks it is still not HTML.
